Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Strong experience developing RESTful APIs and working with SOAP web services.
Solid understanding of integration patterns, message transformation, orchestration, and error handling.
Experience with DataWeave for mapping and transformation logic.
Proficiency with Mule 4.
Experience with API Manager, Runtime Manager, and Exchange.
Familiarity with RAML or OpenAPI/Swagger.
Knowledge of JSON, XML, and XSD.
Experience integrating with databases, file systems, SaaS platforms, and third-party APIs.
Experience with source control and CI/CD tools such as Git, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab.
Strong problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills.

MuleSoft Certified Developer or other MuleSoft certifications.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Familiarity with containerization and deployment tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience with event-driven integration patterns and messaging platforms such as Kafka, JMS, or MQ.
Knowledge of enterprise architecture, microservices, and distributed systems.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.

Meeting with Resilient Co. team.

Panel Interview (Managers and Techical Lead)
